texts.name: Kitty
texts.biography: Kitty has earned the nickname Tremble among the sorceresses due to her supposed shyness. However, this is not entirely true, as it is the other sorceresses who avoid her rather than her. This stems from widespread envy, as she can cast spells in a much more effective than others.

specialty.description: Reduces cost of spells during combat by 2.
specialty.name: -2 Spell Cost
